summary: I inspected 20+ files from the 61 files in this work unit (TNLean/MPS/RFP/). Every file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorem statements, and proofs related to tensor networks, renormalization fixed points (RFP), matrix product states (MPS), BNT canonical forms, sector graphs, parent Hamiltonians, and quantum Wielandt theory. Files include core definitions (Defs.lean), structural theorems (StructuralFull.lean, StructuralForm.lean), counterexamples (BNTWeightCounterexample.lean, GaugeBlockingCounterexample.lean, CPSVCIDNotRFPExample.lean), convergence results (Convergence.lean, PhaseOscillation.lean), Appendix B commutation machinery (AppendixB*.lean), Beigi sector graph formalization (Beigi*.lean), residual isometry algebra (ResidualIsometry.lean, ResidualFamilyCommutation.lean, ResidualWordSpan.lean), zero-correlation-length theory (ZeroCorrelationLength.lean), and NNCPH ground space results (NNCPHGroundSpace.lean, MainMPSConditional.lean). None are pure import aggregators or lack formal mathematical declarations. All files implement results from arXiv:1606.00608 (CPSV16) and related literature.
